item.title: Latin Blues Funk — Thu Jul 23, 9:30 PM — Madam's Organ Blues Bar
item.description:
LBF is a Washington D.C. band which specializes in Latin, Blues and Funk music. Members of LBF have appeared with groups such as the Ohio Players, George Duke, El Gran Combo, Willie Colon, Horace Silver, Ray Barretto, and Young and Rollins. They have also played with local salsa bands such as Peligro, Tentacion, Sin Miedo, Alfredo Mojica and Friends, and Tumbao. https://www.latinbluesfunk.com/
